subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this exact head be authorized to move the Matrix dependency ownership into QA Lab and change gateway channel-restart admission semantics?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well-proven, but repository automation cannot decide whether the dependency graph and production gateway lifecycle boundary are acceptable ownership choices.

options.title: Authorize the exact head
options.body: Approve the workspace dependency relocation and gateway lifecycle seam after the responsible owners confirm the current proof covers their upgrade and reload expectations.

options.title: Split the gateway seam
options.body: Move the admission helper and reload-handler call-site changes into a separate owner-reviewed PR while retaining the QA migration stack.

options.title: Pause the migration stack
options.body: Keep this PR and its successor unmerged until maintainers choose a different Matrix QA ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Authorize the exact head
recommendation.body: Approve the workspace dependency relocation and gateway lifecycle seam after the responsible owners confirm the current proof covers their upgrade and reload expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current migration stack and merged prerequisite and is best positioned to coordinate the required administrator, secops, and gateway-owner decisions.
